styles.era: 10-character serials, 4 digits + letter + 5 digits (Building Center Style 1)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-based over numerical digits: week = 1st & 2nd numerical digits, year = 3rd & 4th numerical digits. The first four characters are digits, so numerical-digit positions coincide with normalized character positions. Week/year values derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.
